title: Settings of the shared HTTP client
description: The settings that every HTTP adapter shares (T-04.4, REQ-OUT-005, REQ-OUT-008). An adapter embeds them in its own configuration; the names below are for ONE HTTP destination, an adapter with several destinations gives each its own prefix. The library reads no file and no environment (ADR-004): the consumer loads the values and passes them in. No URL is fixed in code and no secret has a default (REQ-CFG-005). An empty text means 'not set'. The order of the properties is the order in which a validation reports its problems.

url.description: The URL of the destination, http or https. Required. Authentication over plain http is refused except to localhost.

timeout_ms.description: Milliseconds before a request gives up (default 3000, REQ-DLV-004).

compress.description: Send the body gzipped with Content-Encoding: gzip (default false, REQ-OUT-010).

skip_tls_verification.description: Turn the verification of the TLS certificate OFF. It is on by default and turning it off needs this explicit setting (REQ-SEC-005).

bearer_token.description: A bearer token for the Authorization header. A secret: the consumer gives it, it has no default and it never appears in an error, a log or a diagnostic (REQ-SEC-007). Not together with an API key.

api_key_header.description: The name of the header that carries an API key. Needs api_key_value.

api_key_value.description: The API key. A secret, like the bearer token. Needs api_key_header.

max_attempts.description: Attempts at most for one batch, the first included (default 5). Which destination uses the retries is decided by the delivery mode (T-05.3).

retry_base_delay_ms.description: Base of the exponential backoff in milliseconds (default 200).

retry_max_delay_ms.description: Ceiling of the backoff in milliseconds (default 30000). Not below the base.
